baseline.note: Pinned moby/profiles commit. Not proven identical to the profile embedded in any particular Docker engine; Docker 29.5.2 was the engine used for the tested run.

candidate.derivation: baseline plus exactly one appended unconditional SCMP_ACT_ALLOW rule for clone, unshare, chroot (setns is NOT added); reproduced byte for byte by `scripts/browser_helper_smoke.py derive`.

smoke.mjs.adapted: fail-closed error and deadline handling; strict /proc reads (a live process that cannot be inspected fails the run, only a vanished one is skipped); all four Uid/Gid fields must be 1000; launch argv assertion; outer-userns assertion renamed outer_userns_map_recorded because it only records the map; no machine-local paths

run_smoke.sh.adapted: replaced by scripts/browser_helper_smoke.py (digest-only image, fresh output dir, bounded timeout, hardening assertion, receipt, host-side artefact verification)

derive_min.py.adapted: replaced by the derive command of scripts/browser_helper_smoke.py

seccomp_diff.py.adapted: not imported; the candidate check asserts the one-rule difference directly
